description_en: Triggers a specified metadata crawler to run and returns the submit status and associated task instance information
description_zh: 触发指定元数据采集器运行，并返回受理状态和关联的任务实例信息
name: RunCrawler

parameters.help_en: The ID of the metadata crawler. You can call ListCrawlers to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 元数据采集器 ID。您可以通过 ListCrawlers 查询
parameters.name: id

Id.description_en: The ID of the metadata crawler

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used for locating logs and troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

RunAccepted.description_en: Indicates whether the run request was accepted. A value of true indicates that the request was accepted, but does not indicate that the collection task is complete
RunAccepted.description_zh: 运行请求是否已受理。true 表示已受理，不表示采集任务已经完成

RunStatus.description_en: The initial run status after submission. The value is WAITING when the run request is successfully accepted. To query the final status, call ListCrawlerRuns
RunStatus.description_zh: 提交后的初始运行状态。运行请求成功受理时为 WAITING；最终状态请通过 ListCrawlerRuns 查询

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TaskInstanceId.description_en: The associated DataWorks task instance ID. This field may be empty. To query the final run record, call ListCrawlerRuns
TaskInstanceId.description_zh: 关联的 DataWorks 任务实例 ID。该字段可能为空，最终运行记录请通过 ListCrawlerRuns 查询
